title: Minimum Number of Swaps to Make the String Balanced
goal: Minimize arbitrary swaps needed to balance equal numbers of opening and closing brackets.
strategy: Greedily match each closing bracket with a preceding unmatched opening. The unmatched pattern consists of closings followed by openings; each swap repairs two such mismatches.
